==Description==
This plugin provides support for specifying test cases with included test steps. Results of test cases can be documents in test protocols. Test Cases can be linked to Use Cases.

===Contact===
Alexander Delater (delater@informatik.uni-heidelberg.de)

===Link to update-site===
Please use the following update-site for installing the plugin:
http://unicase.googlecode.com/svn/trunk/other/heidelberg/integrated/update (Available soon)

The plugin is integrated with the following plugins: [Use_Cases], [Metrics] and [Context_Completeness]. These plugins are installed together with the test case plugin.

===Tutorial for users===
Create a new element "TestCase" from the package "testcase" in UNICASE. The element has several attributes, e.g. pre- and post condition and infrastructure. Navigate to the new page "Test Steps". Test Steps can have Input- and Output parameter, a short description and exception. For each parameter, the name, type and rage can be specified. 

[http://unicase.googlecode.com/svn/trunk/other/heidelberg/plugin-resources/teststep.png]
